about: Machine-checked manifest for the editable CouncilSpec preset library, lane build/preset-4. Scope: global ordinals 49-64 of the 72 designs in 12-COUNCIL-PROTOCOLS-AND-PRESETS.md (whose ids form a single global sequence C-M01=1 ... C-H72=72), plus THREE gap-closers for REQUIRED preset names that a measured cross-lane scan found covered by zero files (GAP-AUTO and GAP-WATCH have no design entry at all; GAP-ROADMAP follows design C-H65, which sits outside the 64-preset budget and is therefore owned by no lane). platform/council/presets/ is SHARED with three sibling lanes, so this manifest and its gate police ONLY the doc ids listed here. Every owned .councilspec.json must appear below or the gate fails - an unlisted file is an untested file. Each case carries a both-states control: metrics_satisfying must stop the council and metrics_not_satisfying must not, because a stopping rule proven in only one state measures nothing. `isolates` names the single clause each negative probe is designed to falsify.
range: council presets 49-64 of 64, plus GAP-AUTO / GAP-ROADMAP / GAP-WATCH
status: COMPLETE - 19 of 19 authored (16 design-derived + 3 gap-closers); the gate output is the receipt, not this line
coverage_line: 16 design-derived presets (C-X49..C-H64) + 3 gap-closers for REQUIRED preset names a measured cross-lane scan found covered by zero files. Doc ordinals 65-72 (C-H65..C-H72) are owned by NO lane; C-H65 is built here only because roadmap_prioritization would otherwise be missing. C-H66..C-H72 remain unbuilt - reported, not silently dropped.

known_substrate_defects.leaf_note_vs_source_expression: A stop leaf may carry `note` (and a custom leaf `producer`) per the schema, but SEM-001 compares parse(source_expression) to stopping.expression by DICT EQUALITY and councilspec.expression.parse emits neither key. Declaring source_expression therefore forbids both. Every preset here keeps source_expression (the documentation-cannot-lie guarantee) and moves per-metric prose and producer attribution into metadata.notes. Consequence: one SEM-012 WARN per custom leaf, expected and non-blocking. Probe: platform/council/_probe_note_vs_source_expression.py
known_substrate_defects.weighted_branch_unparse_only: The schema's `weighted` stop_expression is emitted by unparse() as WEIGHTED[...] >= t, which parse() cannot read (no WEIGHTED production). A weighted spec can neither declare source_expression nor pass a parse(unparse(tree)) idempotence check, though it is schema-valid and evaluates correctly. No preset here uses weighted. Probe: platform/council/_probe_weighted_roundtrip.py
known_substrate_defects.committees_need_roster_ids: SEM-006 requires every topology.committees[].members entry to be a roster participant_id, so a council whose seats are auto-selected cannot declare committees or caucuses structurally. C-X49 (100 seats, 6 pinned) therefore uses topology.kind `committee` with NO committees array and assigns lanes at runtime.
known_substrate_defects.no_editable_dials_field: The design doc gives every preset an `editable_dials` list, but CouncilSpec has no field for it and additionalProperties is false at every level, so the dials are carried as a labelled EDITABLE DIALS section inside metadata.notes. The gate asserts that section exists in every preset rather than trusting it.
known_substrate_defects.no_binding_mode_field: The design doc's `default binding` (advisory / binding / shadow) has no schema field. It is encoded through outcomes.allowed: a shadow council allows ONLY conditional_decision (C-X51), a binding council allows `decision`. Documented per preset.

cases.source_expression: custom:lane_completeness_ratio >= 1 AND unique_ideas >= 250 AND NOT custom:byte_floor_gate_used == true
cases.isolates: the NOT clause: a byte floor used as the completeness gate must block the stop even when every lane is complete and the idea target is met

cases.source_expression: custom:mechanical_coverage_ratio >= 1 AND custom:agent_touched_outside_residue == false AND every_objection_addressed == true
cases.isolates: partial mechanical coverage (0.98) must NOT stop the council - that state is exactly the one that produced the measured data-loss errors
19 resolutions per seat must NOT unlock weight movement - the resolution floor is the whole point of the preset

cases.source_expression: custom:event_name_in_events_tuple == true AND custom:hook_observed_firing == true AND experiments_passed >= 1
cases.isolates: a valid event name with NO observed fire must not admit the hook - the design's whole point is that a green conformance gate does not prove the hook will ever be called

cases.source_expression: custom:transport_proven_on_control_file == true AND custom:rollback_executed_once == true AND NOT custom:fail_open_exit_zero_count_zero == true
cases.isolates: the fail-open shape - exit 0 with a zero-file count - must deny authorisation even when both positive proofs are present

cases.source_expression: custom:per_check_cost_measured == true AND custom:headroom_computed == true AND custom:disarmed_baseline_stated == true
cases.isolates: measured costs and computed headroom are not enough: an allocation against an unstated DISARMED baseline is arithmetic on fiction

cases.source_expression: custom:blast_radius_fully_enumerated == true AND custom:rotation_scheduled_with_owner == true AND custom:secret_value_printed == false
cases.isolates: a printed credential value must block closure even on a complete radius with rotation scheduled - the never-print rule is not tradeable against thoroughness

cases.source_expression: custom:six_autoload_surfaces_inspected == true AND custom:autoload_config_neutralised == true AND evidence_items >= 6
cases.isolates: five anchors cannot substantiate six inspected surfaces; the arithmetic floor is what makes the boolean expensive to assert

cases.source_expression: custom:offset_rederived_in_fresh_context == true AND custom:aob_signature_or_diff_cited == true AND independent_positions >= 2
cases.isolates: one position is one signal: a fresh-context derivation that silently reproduces the original leaves nothing to compare

cases.source_expression: custom:cost_estimate_has_reference_class == true AND custom:teardown_path_named == true AND owner_approved == true
cases.isolates: a sound estimate and a named teardown do not authorise spend; owner approval is a required clause, and silence is not approval

cases.source_expression: custom:quality_measured == true AND custom:cost_measured == true AND custom:latency_measured == true AND experiments_passed >= 3
cases.isolates: an unmeasured third axis makes the candidate unranked, not merely weaker - two of three axes must not close the selection

cases.source_expression: custom:catalogue_tax_computed == true AND custom:hook_surface_enumerated == true AND custom:disable_verified_at_user_scope == true AND owner_approved == true
cases.isolates: an unverified user-scope disable blocks admission even with owner approval - a plugin that cannot be reliably disabled is effectively permanent

cases.source_expression: custom:tool_count_stated == true AND custom:token_cost_per_turn_measured == true AND custom:egress_surface_enumerated == true AND custom:auth_model_stated == true AND evidence_items >= 4
cases.isolates: an unmeasured per-turn token cost blocks admission: three of four facts is not the standard, and a README figure is not a measurement
a supersession pointer without a valid_as_of on the replacement leaves the new note undated and unrankable - both sides or neither

cases.source_expression: custom:named_routes_verified_present == true AND custom:both_states_example_given == true AND objections_open == 0
cases.isolates: one open objection blocks the rule from landing - equality to zero is the only form that means dispositioned rather than outvoted
scoring a build option before enumeration closes must block the ranking - the ordering IS the rule, because scoring build first anchors every later comparison

cases.source_expression: (confidence >= 0.8 AND every_objection_addressed == true) OR (owner_approved == true AND rounds_elapsed >= 1)
cases.isolates: the substance route alone: confidence 0.7 with objections addressed and NO owner approval must not stop the council, proving the disjunction is not vacuously true. Zero expected warnings because every clause uses a registry metric - the only preset in the lane with no custom extension.
cases.gap_reason: REQUIRED by the spec (the schema preset_name enum plus the lane brief) but absent from all 72 designs in 12-COUNCIL-PROTOCOLS-AND-PRESETS.md: a case-insensitive grep for auto.composed / auto_composed / autocompose over that file returns zero hits, so no lane's doc-derived slice would have produced it.

cases.isolates: a computed overlap matrix that does NOT separate byte-identical overlap from real conflict must not produce an order - that conflation is what turns a stackable set into an imagined rebase marathon
cases.gap_reason: Faithful to design C-H65 `pr-merge-order-council` (12-COUNCIL-PROTOCOLS-AND-PRESETS.md:2105), but doc ordinals 65-72 fall outside the program's 64-preset budget so NO lane owns them. A measured cross-lane scan found the required name `roadmap_prioritization` covered by zero files, so it is closed here rather than left missing.

cases.source_expression: (custom:every_invariant_probed_this_cycle == true AND custom:cycle_verdict_clean == true) OR (custom:trigger_corroborated_and_escalated == true AND owner_approved == true)
cases.isolates: the negative state is the exact failure a standing watch exists to prevent: a clean-looking verdict where not every invariant was probed, plus a fired trigger the owner never acknowledged. Neither branch of the disjunction may fire, so a silent pass is structurally impossible.
cases.gap_reason: REQUIRED by the spec but absent from all 72 designs: a case-insensitive grep for standing.watch / standing_watch / watch.council / vigil / sentinel over 12-COUNCIL-PROTOCOLS-AND-PRESETS.md returns zero hits, and a measured cross-lane scan found the name covered by zero files.
